0022600094.text: The Charlotte Hornets (1-0, 3rd in the Southeast, 6th in the East) host the Atlanta Hawks (1-0, 1st in the Southeast, 2nd in the East) in Charlotte's second game of the season, with both teams unbeaten and the Hornets still without a home game this year. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery), while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The Hornets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 110-107 win over the Hawks in Charlotte on February 11, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
